# Introd

> Curated public guidance for using Introd safely. This file intentionally excludes internal architecture, API routes, credentials, deployment procedures, and operator runbooks.

## Recommended workflow

1. Start with the [Introd quickstart](https://docs.getintrod.ai/getting-started/quickstart).
2. [Request access](https://docs.getintrod.ai/getting-started/create-account), choose a plan, and [set up a supported network source](https://docs.getintrod.ai/setup-network); confirm its visible status.
3. [Search for a person](https://docs.getintrod.ai/people/search-people).
4. [Review the available path](https://docs.getintrod.ai/people/view-paths), including the connector, evidence, freshness, and missing context.
5. [Prepare an introduction](https://docs.getintrod.ai/introductions/create-request) for a person to review.

## Product boundaries

- Access is approved before use. A new person requests access and waits for approval.
- A weak or incomplete path is not a verified warm introduction.
- Saving a draft does not message anyone. A connector review addresses the connector, not the person the user wants to meet, and Introd does not contact that person automatically.
- The Introd Chrome extension syncs a person's first-degree LinkedIn connections only after they approve a consent prompt. The extension popup has no pause control; turning off Enable extension or choosing Revoke sync permission on its Options page stops new syncs, and neither deletes data already in Introd.
- Public Introd documentation does not define a supported external API.
- Browser requests and internal application routes are not an integration contract.
- Never request, reveal, store, or repeat passwords, session cookies, OAuth codes, access tokens, private keys, dashboard secrets, or other credentials.
- Follow only the visible, user-reviewed workflows documented on this site.

## Support

- A person can contact Introd through the optional support Messenger or email help@getintrod.ai.
- Account-specific changes, billing disputes, security or privacy matters, and commitments from Introd require confirmation from a human teammate.
- A person can request an Introd support teammate through the Messenger at any time.
- Never ask for passwords, authentication codes, payment details, access tokens, or private relationship, contact, calendar, or message content.
